1	# platform-gateway-starter
2	
3	Spring Cloud Gateway 统一认证与安全过滤 starter。新项目引入此 starter 并完成配置，即可获得 JWT 用户认证和 HMAC 系统间签名认证能力，无需重复开发网关安全层。
4	
5	## 快速开始
6	
7	### 1. 添加依赖
8	
9	```xml
10	<dependency>
11	    <groupId>com.maritime.platform</groupId>
12	    <artifactId>platform-gateway-starter</artifactId>
13	    <version>1.0.9</version>
14	</dependency>
15	```
16	
17	### 2. 启动类
18	
19	```java
20	@SpringBootApplication
21	public class GatewayApplication {
22	    public static void main(String[] args) {
23	        SpringApplication.run(GatewayApplication.class, args);
24	    }
25	}
26	```
27	
28	无需 `@EnableXxx` 注解，starter 通过 Spring Boot 自动配置生效。
29	
30	### 3. 最小 `application.yml`
31	
32	```yaml
33	spring:
34	  cloud:
35	    gateway:
36	      routes:
37	        - id: your-service
38	          uri: http://localhost:8081
39	          predicates:
40	            - Path=/api/**
41	
42	maritime:
43	  gateway:
44	    security:
45	      # 默认认证模式（JWT 用户请求）
46	      default-auth-mode: jwt
47	      # 公开路径（跳过认证）
48	      public-paths:
49	        - /api/public/**
50	        - /actuator/health
51	      jwt:
52	        enabled: true
53	        secret: <your-jwt-hmac-secret>
54	        issuer: <your-jwt-issuer>
55	      hmac:
56	        enabled: true
57	```
58	
59	> 需要 Redis 连接。JWT nonce、session、blacklist、HMAC nonce 和 app credential 均依赖 Redis。
60	
61	## 认证模式
62	
63	| 模式 | 说明 |
64	|------|------|
65	| `NONE` | 跳过认证，仅保留 header 清理和 trace ID 注入 |
66	| `JWT` | Bearer token 认证，适用于用户请求 |
67	| `HMAC` | 签名认证，适用于系统间调用 |
68	| `JWT_OR_HMAC` | JWT 或 HMAC 二选一，先尝试 JWT，无 Bearer token 则走 HMAC |
69	| `JWT_AND_HMAC` | **预留能力，当前版本不可用。** 配置后启动即报错 |
70	
71	认证模式可在三个层级指定（优先级从高到低）：路由规则 → 默认模式。`public-paths` 列表中的路径始终为 `NONE`。
72	
73	```yaml
74	maritime:
75	  gateway:
76	    security:
77	      default-auth-mode: jwt-or-hmac
78	      routes:
79	        - id: external-api
80	          paths:
81	            - /api/external/**
82	          auth-mode: hmac                # 仅系统调用
83	        - id: user-api
84	          paths:
85	            - /api/user/**
86	          auth-mode: jwt                 # 仅用户请求
87	```
88	
89	## JWT 用户请求认证
90	
91	### 请求标准
92	
93	客户端在 `Authorization: Bearer <token>` 中携带 JWT。对 POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE 请求，还需携带 `X-Nonce` 防重放。
94	
95	### 服务端校验链
96	
97	1. 提取 Bearer token → 缺失则返回 `MISSING_TOKEN`
98	2. 解密（若 `jwt.encrypted=true`）→ 失败则返回 `INVALID_TOKEN`
99	3. 验证签名、issuer、过期 → 失败则返回 `INVALID_TOKEN` / `TOKEN_EXPIRED`
100	4. 检查 session 存在于 Redis → 不存在则返回 `SESSION_EXPIRED`
101	5. 检查 JTI 不在 Redis 黑名单 → 在黑名单则返回 `TOKEN_BLACKLISTED`
102	6. 检查用户启用状态 → 禁用则返回 `USER_DISABLED`
103	7. 写请求校验 `X-Nonce` 防重放 → 缺失返回 `NONCE_REQUIRED`，重复返回 `REPLAY_DETECTED`
104	
105	### JWT 校验开关
106	
107	```yaml
108	jwt:
109	  validation:
110	    require-session: true        # 是否校验 session
111	    check-blacklist: true        # 是否校验黑名单
112	    check-user-enabled: true     # 是否校验用户启用状态
113	  nonce:
114	    enabled: true                # 是否启用写请求 nonce 防重放
115	```
116	
117	## HMAC 系统请求认证
118	
119	### 请求标准
120	
121	调用方在请求中携带以下 header：
122	
123	| Header | 说明 |
124	|--------|------|
125	| `X-App-Key` | 应用标识 |
126	| `X-Timestamp` | Unix 时间戳（秒），允许偏差默认 5 分钟 |
127	| `X-Nonce` | 随机字符串，最短 16 字符，防重放 |
128	| `X-Body-Digest` | 请求体 SHA-256 hex |
129	| `X-Signature` | HMAC-SHA256 签名 |
130	
131	签名 base string 为换行符连接的规范请求（由 starter 内部构建），密钥为 `appSecret`。
132	
133	### 服务端校验链
134	
135	1. 检查 header 完整性 → 缺失返回 `MISSING_HMAC_HEADERS`
136	2. 校验时间戳在容忍窗口内 → 超时返回 `TIMESTAMP_EXPIRED`
137	3. 校验 nonce 长度 ≥ 16（可配）→ 过短返回 `INVALID_SIGNATURE`
138	4. 对比 body digest → 不匹配返回 `INVALID_SIGNATURE`
139	5. nonce 防重放（Redis SETNX）→ 重复返回 `REPLAY_DETECTED`
140	6. 查找 app credential（Redis 优先，config fallback）→ 未找到返回 `UNKNOWN_APP`
141	7. 检查 app 启用状态 → 禁用返回 `APP_DISABLED`
142	8. 验证 HMAC 签名 → 失败返回 `INVALID_SIGNATURE`
143	
144	### App Credential 配置
145	
146	默认从 Redis hash `iam:app:auth:{appKey}` 读取，也可在配置中静态声明 fallback：
147	
148	```yaml
149	hmac:
150	  credentials:
151	    apps:
152	      - app-key: my-system
153	        app-secret: <shared-secret>
154	        app-code: MY_SYS
155	```
156	
157	## Header 清理与注入
158	
159	### 过滤链
160	
161	过滤器按固定顺序执行，保证安全语义：
162	
163	| 顺序 | 过滤器 | 作用 |
164	|------|--------|------|
165	| 1 | TraceIdGatewayFilter | 捕获或生成 trace ID |
166	| 2 | UntrustedHeaderStripFilter | 清除所有不信任的内部 header |
167	| 3 | RequestLogGatewayFilter | 调试日志 |
168	| 4 | RouteSecurityPolicyFilter | 解析路由认证策略 |
169	| 5 | JwtAuthenticationGatewayFilter | JWT 认证 |
170	| 6 | JwtNonceGatewayFilter | JWT nonce 防重放 |
171	| 7 | HmacAuthenticationGatewayFilter | HMAC 认证 |
172	| 8 | ContextHeaderInjectionFilter | 注入已验证的身份 header |
173	
174	### 清理清单
175	
176	以下 header **对所有请求**（含公开路径）无条件移除，确保客户端无法伪造内部身份：
177	
178	```
179	X-Internal-Call
180	X-User-Id, X-User-Name
181	X-Active-Org-Code, X-Active-Org-Name
182	X-Session-Id
183	X-System-Scope
184	X-User-Source
185	X-Tenant-Id, X-Tenant-Code
186	X-App-Key, X-App-Code, X-App-Id
187	X-Verified-App-Code
188	X-App-Permissions
189	X-Trace-Id
190	```
191	
192	### 注入清单
193	
194	**JWT 用户认证通过后注入：**
195	
196	```
197	X-User-Id, X-User-Name
198	X-Active-Org-Code, X-Active-Org-Name
199	X-Tenant-Id
200	X-Session-Id
201	X-System-Scope        (List → 逗号拼接)
202	X-User-Source
203	```
204	
205	**HMAC 应用认证通过后注入：**
206	
207	```
208	X-Verified-App-Code, X-App-Code   (均设置为 appCode)
209	X-App-Id
210	X-Tenant-Code, X-Tenant-Id
211	X-App-Permissions                  (List → 逗号拼接)
212	```
213	
214	## 统一错误响应
215	
216	所有认证错误返回统一 JSON 格式：
217	
218	```json
219	{
220	  "code": 401,
221	  "message": "MISSING_TOKEN",
222	  "data": null
223	}
224	```
225	
226	响应头包含 `X-Trace-Id` 用于链路追踪。
227	
228	### 错误码速查
229	
230	| 错误码 | HTTP | 触发条件 |
231	|--------|------|----------|
232	| `MISSING_TOKEN` | 401 | 缺少 Bearer token |
233	| `INVALID_TOKEN` | 401 | JWT 解析/签名/claims 失败 |
234	| `TOKEN_EXPIRED` | 401 | JWT 过期 |
235	| `SESSION_EXPIRED` | 401 | Redis 中无 session |
236	| `TOKEN_BLACKLISTED` | 401 | JTI 在黑名单中 |
237	| `USER_DISABLED` | 401 | 用户被禁用 |
238	| `NONCE_REQUIRED` | 401 | 写请求缺少 X-Nonce |
239	| `REPLAY_DETECTED` | 401 | nonce 重复（JWT 或 HMAC） |
240	| `MISSING_HMAC_HEADERS` | 401 | HMAC header 缺失 |
241	| `TIMESTAMP_EXPIRED` | 401 | 时间戳超出容忍窗口 |
242	| `INVALID_SIGNATURE` | 401 | HMAC 签名/body digest/哈希不匹配 |
243	| `UNKNOWN_APP` | 401 | appKey 未找到 |
244	| `APP_DISABLED` | 401 | 应用被禁用 |
245	| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | 预留，当前未使用 |
246	| `UNSUPPORTED_AUTH_MODE` | 501 | 配置了 JWT_AND_HMAC |
247	
248	## 与 iam-sdk 的关系
249	
250	`platform-gateway-starter` **不依赖** `iam-sdk`，两者在编译期独立，在运行期通过共享 Redis key 约定协作：
251	
252	| Redis Key 前缀 | 写入方 | 读取方 (gateway-starter) |
253	|----------------|--------|--------------------------|
254	| `iam:session:` | IAM 服务 | JWT session 校验 |
255	| `iam:token:blacklist:` | IAM 服务 | JWT 黑名单校验 |
256	| `iam:user:enabled:` | IAM 服务 | 用户启用状态校验 |
257	| `iam:app:auth:` | IAM 服务 | HMAC app credential 查询 |
258	
259	所有 Redis key 前缀均可通过配置覆盖，因此耦合是软的。
260	
261	**下游微服务需要租户、用户、应用权限数据时**，应手动引入 `iam-sdk` 或对应的业务 SDK。gateway-starter 仅在网关层做认证鉴权，不向下游透传 IAM 数据模型。具体来说：
262	
263	- gateway-starter 通过 header 传递身份标识（userId、tenantId、appCode 等），下游可直接读取这些 header。
264	- 如需做数据权限过滤、租户隔离等 IAM 领域逻辑，需要 `iam-sdk` 提供的 `@PermissionFilter` 等能力。
265	
266	## 扩展点
267	
268	| 接口 | 用途 | 默认实现 |
269	|------|------|----------|
270	| `GatewayErrorWriter` | 自定义错误响应格式 | `DefaultGatewayErrorWriter`（JSON 统一格式） |
271	| `JwtClaimsMapper` | 自定义 JWT claims → Principal 映射 | `DefaultJwtClaimsMapper` |
272	| `AppCredentialResolver` | 自定义 app credential 获取逻辑 | `DefaultAppCredentialResolver`（Redis + config fallback） |
273	| `GatewaySecurityPolicyCustomizer` | 编程式注册路由策略 | 无（按需实现 Bean） |
274	| `GatewayPrincipalHeaderCustomizer` | 注入额外自定义 header | 无（按需实现 Bean） |
275	
276	实现对应接口并注册为 Spring Bean 即可替换或增强默认行为。
277	
278	## Starter 范围说明
279	
280	本 starter 负责**网关层通用认证与安全**，以下内容**不在** starter 范围内：
281	
282	- Todo / IAM / Process 等特定业务模块的特殊规则
283	- 业务级别的权限校验（角色、菜单、按钮等）
284	- 多租户数据隔离逻辑
285	- 下游微服务框架集成
286	
287	这些规则由各自的业务模块自行实现。starter 保持通用、无业务耦合。

### 4.12 Filter Classes

All are `GlobalFilter` + `Ordered` with `@Component` and `@Order(GatewayFilterOrder.XXX)`.

**GatewayFilterOrder** constants:
```
TRACE_ID                    = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE
UNTRUSTED_HEADER_STRIP      = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 5
REQUEST_LOG                 = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 10
SECURITY_POLICY             = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 20
JWT_AUTHENTICATION          = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 25
JWT_NONCE                   = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 28
HMAC_AUTHENTICATION         = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 29
CONTEXT_HEADER_INJECTION    = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 30
```

**RouteSecurityPolicyFilter**:
- Resolves `RouteSecurityPolicy` from `RouteSecurityPolicyResolver`
- Stores in exchange attribute `"gateway.securityPolicy"`
- Always passes through to next filter

**JwtAuthenticationGatewayFilter** (`@ConditionalOnProperty("maritime.gateway.security.jwt.enabled")`):
- Reads policy from `ROUTE_SECURITY_POLICY_ATTR`
- Skips for NONE, HMAC, null policy
- Returns UNSUPPORTED_AUTH_MODE (501) for JWT_AND_HMAC
- For JWT_OR_HMAC without Bearer token: passes through
- Extracts `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- Returns MISSING_TOKEN (via error writer) if no token
- Calls `JwtAuthenticationManager.authenticate(token)` and stores principal in `"gateway.principal"`
- Catches `JwtAuthenticationException` and writes error

**JwtNonceGatewayFilter** (`@ConditionalOnProperty("maritime.gateway.security.jwt.enabled")`):
- Skips if nonce disabled globally
- Skips if policy does not require JWT
- Skips if HTTP method not in `requiredMethods`
- Skips if no principal (e.g. JWT_OR_HMAC route without Bearer token, handled upstream by JWT filter)
- Returns NONCE_REQUIRED if X-Nonce header missing/empty
- Calls `JwtNonceValidator.validate(sessionId, nonce)`
- Catches JwtAuthenticationException -> error response

**HmacAuthenticationGatewayFilter** (`@ConditionalOnProperty("maritime.gateway.security.hmac.enabled")`):
- Skips for NONE, JWT, null policy
- Returns UNSUPPORTED_AUTH_MODE (501) for JWT_AND_HMAC
- For JWT_OR_HMAC with Bearer token: passes through (JWT handles it)
- Returns MISSING_HMAC_HEADERS if any of 5 required headers missing
- Reads and caches request body (for digest calculation + downstream re-read)
- Calls `HmacAuthenticationManager.authenticate(...)`
- Stores `GatewayPrincipal.App` in exchange
- Catches `JwtAuthenticationException` -> error

**UntrustedHeaderStripFilter** (no conditional -- always active):
- Strips 16 headers from ALL requests including public paths
- Stripped: X-Internal-Call, X-User-Id, X-User-Name, X-Active-Org-Code, X-Active-Org-Name, X-Tenant-Id, X-Tenant-Code, X-Session-Id, X-System-Scope, X-User-Source, X-App-Key, X-App-Code, X-App-Id, X-Verified-App-Code, X-App-Permissions, X-Trace-Id

**ContextHeaderInjectionFilter**:
- Reads principal from exchange attribute
- Calls `TrustedHeaderWriter.writeUserHeaders()` or `.writeAppHeaders()`
- Invokes all `GatewayPrincipalHeaderCustomizer` beans
- Mutates request and forwards

**TrustedHeaderWriter**:
```java
ServerHttpRequest.Builder writeUserHeaders(builder, GatewayPrincipal.User user)
ServerHttpRequest.Builder writeAppHeaders(builder, GatewayPrincipal.App app)
```
User headers: X-User-Id, X-User-Name, X-Active-Org-Code, X-Active-Org-Name, X-Tenant-Id, X-Session-Id, X-System-Scope, X-User-Source
App headers: X-Verified-App-Code, X-App-Code, X-App-Id, X-Tenant-Code, X-Tenant-Id, X-App-Permissions
Null fields -> empty string; List -> comma-joined.

**TraceIdGatewayFilter**:
- Reuses `X-Trace-Id` header from request if present
- Otherwise generates UUID without dashes
- Sets trace ID on both exchange attribute and response header

**RequestLogGatewayFilter**:
- Logs method, path, traceId at DEBUG level

### 4.12 Filter Classes

All are `GlobalFilter` + `Ordered` with `@Component` and `@Order(GatewayFilterOrder.XXX)`.

**GatewayFilterOrder** constants:
```
TRACE_ID                    = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE
UNTRUSTED_HEADER_STRIP      = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 5
REQUEST_LOG                 = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 10
SECURITY_POLICY             = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 20
JWT_AUTHENTICATION          = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 25
JWT_NONCE                   = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 28
HMAC_AUTHENTICATION         = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 29
CONTEXT_HEADER_INJECTION    = HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 30
```

**RouteSecurityPolicyFilter**:
- Resolves `RouteSecurityPolicy` from `RouteSecurityPolicyResolver`
- Stores in exchange attribute `"gateway.securityPolicy"`
- Always passes through to next filter

**JwtAuthenticationGatewayFilter** (`@ConditionalOnProperty("maritime.gateway.security.jwt.enabled")`):
- Reads policy from `ROUTE_SECURITY_POLICY_ATTR`
- Skips for NONE, HMAC, null policy
- Returns UNSUPPORTED_AUTH_MODE (501) for JWT_AND_HMAC
- For JWT_OR_HMAC without Bearer token: passes through
- Extracts `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- Returns MISSING_TOKEN (via error writer) if no token
- Calls `JwtAuthenticationManager.authenticate(token)` and stores principal in `"gateway.principal"`
- Catches `JwtAuthenticationException` and writes error

**JwtNonceGatewayFilter** (`@ConditionalOnProperty("maritime.gateway.security.jwt.enabled")`):
- Skips if nonce disabled globally
- Skips if policy does not require JWT
- Skips if HTTP method not in `requiredMethods`
- Skips if no principal (e.g. JWT_OR_HMAC route without Bearer token, handled upstream by JWT filter)
- Returns NONCE_REQUIRED if X-Nonce header missing/empty
- Calls `JwtNonceValidator.validate(sessionId, nonce)`
- Catches JwtAuthenticationException -> error response

**HmacAuthenticationGatewayFilter** (`@ConditionalOnProperty("maritime.gateway.security.hmac.enabled")`):
- Skips for NONE, JWT, null policy
- Returns UNSUPPORTED_AUTH_MODE (501) for JWT_AND_HMAC
- For JWT_OR_HMAC with Bearer token: passes through (JWT handles it)
- Returns MISSING_HMAC_HEADERS if any of 5 required headers missing
- Reads and caches request body (for digest calculation + downstream re-read)
- Calls `HmacAuthenticationManager.authenticate(...)`
- Stores `GatewayPrincipal.App` in exchange
- Catches `JwtAuthenticationException` -> error

**UntrustedHeaderStripFilter** (no conditional -- always active):
- Strips 16 headers from ALL requests including public paths
- Stripped: X-Internal-Call, X-User-Id, X-User-Name, X-Active-Org-Code, X-Active-Org-Name, X-Tenant-Id, X-Tenant-Code, X-Session-Id, X-System-Scope, X-User-Source, X-App-Key, X-App-Code, X-App-Id, X-Verified-App-Code, X-App-Permissions, X-Trace-Id

**ContextHeaderInjectionFilter**:
- Reads principal from exchange attribute
- Calls `TrustedHeaderWriter.writeUserHeaders()` or `.writeAppHeaders()`
- Invokes all `GatewayPrincipalHeaderCustomizer` beans
- Mutates request and forwards

**TrustedHeaderWriter**:
```java
ServerHttpRequest.Builder writeUserHeaders(builder, GatewayPrincipal.User user)
ServerHttpRequest.Builder writeAppHeaders(builder, GatewayPrincipal.App app)
```
User headers: X-User-Id, X-User-Name, X-Active-Org-Code, X-Active-Org-Name, X-Tenant-Id, X-Session-Id, X-System-Scope, X-User-Source
App headers: X-Verified-App-Code, X-App-Code, X-App-Id, X-Tenant-Code, X-Tenant-Id, X-App-Permissions
Null fields -> empty string; List -> comma-joined.

**TraceIdGatewayFilter**:
- Reuses `X-Trace-Id` header from request if present
- Otherwise generates UUID without dashes
- Sets trace ID on both exchange attribute and response header

**RequestLogGatewayFilter**:
- Logs method, path, traceId at DEBUG level
